entries.title: Application label conflicts during manifest merge
entries.root_cause: The app and the tidepanel library both declare different application labels without a merge rule. Resolve the label conflict in the app manifest.

entries.title: Duplicate Android string resource
entries.root_cause: Two values files in the app's main resource set define the string berth_caption. Remove or rename one of the duplicate definitions.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Both jobs fail during Android merging with conflicting declarations, but this is a duplicate resource within one source set rather than a manifest attribute conflict.

entries.title: Duplicate Android string resource remains
entries.root_cause: Two values files in the app's main resource set define the string berth_caption. Remove or rename one of the duplicate definitions.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later release build uses another runner and reports the same duplicate definitions at shifted lines after resource edits.

entries.title: Heading formatter returns the wrong boundary value
entries.root_cause: HeadingFormatter rounds 359.6 degrees to 360 instead of wrapping the rounded value to zero. Correct the formatter's wraparound calculation.
